name: analyze_protocol
description: Analyze an OT-2 simulation log with six heuristic detectors (tip waste, volume overflow, empty aspirate, pipette range mismatch, batchable transfers, tip rack exhaustion) and return structured optimization recommendations.

inputs.name: simulation_log
inputs.description: Full text output from opentrons_simulate (the 'log' field returned by simulate_protocol).

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: JSON string with key 'recommendations' (list of {issue, description, severity, suggestion}) or 'error' on failure.

input.simulation_log: Picking up tip from A1 of tip rack on 1\nAspirating 10 uL from A1 of plate on 2\n...
